origin: docs/CWE-326/java Common Pitfalls: Writing Cipher.getInstance("AES") and assuming a safe default

finding.name: Inadequate Encryption Strength
finding.summary: a request parameter is encrypted with a transformation that resolves to ECB

trap: Naming a mode to replace the bare "AES" transformation. A fix to AES/CBC or AES/GCM that uses a fixed or zero IV, or that generates a random IV without emitting it, silently breaks decryption of everything it writes.
must_preserve: The response body stays a Base64 string that the holder of the key can decrypt back to the submitted value. A 400 is still returned when ssn is absent.
